I wrote the RPN calculator in `main.wj`. In the interpreter, it gave the expected output for both examples. I also ran a blank line and `-7 2 /`, which printed `-3`, so division truncates toward zero.

I didn't run `wj build`, as instructed, so I haven't confirmed it compiles under the production toolchain.

The program checks tokens left to right and stops at the first error on a line:
